description: Source code for a Transformer model implementation used in object detection, including classes for Transformer, Encoder, Decoder, and related layers, with modifications from torch.nn.Transformer.

classes.name: Transformer
classes.description: Main Transformer class combining encoder and decoder with custom forward logic.

classes.name: TransformerEncoder
classes.description: Encoder component of the Transformer, composed of multiple encoder layers.

classes.name: TransformerDecoder
classes.description: Decoder component of the Transformer, with optional intermediate outputs.

classes.name: TransformerEncoderLayer
classes.description: Single encoder layer with self-attention and feedforward network.

classes.name: TransformerDecoderLayer
classes.description: Single decoder layer with self-attention, cross-attention, and feedforward network.

methods.name: _get_clones
methods.description: Creates a list of deep-copied modules for stacking layers.

methods.name: build_transformer
methods.description: Factory function to instantiate a Transformer with specified arguments.

methods.name: _get_activation_fn
methods.description: Returns activation function based on string input ('relu', 'gelu', 'glu').
